disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SE cadmium for cheese from six producing countries sold in Najaf, Iraq.

study.design: market survey of 72 cheese samples grouped by country of production, with EDI, THQ and cancer risk
study.origin: Iran (15), Iraq (9), Egypt (9), Turkey (15), Hungary (15), Saudi Arabia (9)
study.market: different markets in Najaf Governorate, Iraq
study.method: dried 70 °C, HNO3/HClO4 (10:1) wet digestion, flame AAS (Shimadzu AA7000)

findings.group: cheese from Iran, markets of Najaf Governorate, Iraq, September 2022

unresolved: Abstract says the highest average cadmium was in Iranian cheese; the text and Table 1 show Turkey highest.
The introduction says the aim is to analyze lead, but only cadmium is reported.

Reference 4 (Muneam and Abojassim 2022, Ann Biol 38(1):123-7) assessed Egyptian and Saudi cheeses in Iraqi markets; whether the 9 Egyptian and 9 Saudi samples here are the same batches cannot be confirmed from this paper (that paper is not in this chunk).
Cheese type (white, processed, etc.) not specified beyond 'canned cheese'.
No LOD, CRM or recovery reported.
